reason: The bricks and metal stock seem like a plausible structure for a seat or work surface, so I’ll start with those.
expectation: I expect them to make a basic support or frame, though I’m unsure exactly what.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric could make a cushion, but a supporting structure seems useful first.

effect: The bricks and metal made the bench and worktop, so it now has a supporting structure.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the salvaged materials become a place to sit by the window.
reason: Combining the felt and fabric is the only offered gameplay action and may make the bench more comfortable.
expectation: I expect a cushion or padding, though I am not sure how it will be used.

effect: The felt and fabric made a cushion that can now be added to the bench.
reaction: The result was predictable, but it fits the goal neatly.
reason: The cushion and bench naturally belong together, and this is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect a padded window bench that completes the place to sit and work.

effect: The cushion completed the bench and the goal, giving the cabin a place to sit and work by the window.
reaction: The image of watching the sunset from the padded bench makes the finished object feel personal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the bench from bricks and salvaged metal was most worthwhile: it gave familiar materials a practical new use.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and adding the cushion was predictable, with only one gameplay action offered at each step, though it finished the bench neatly.

surprise.text: The finished bench included a worktop as well as a seat; I had initially expected a more basic support.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the materials and their uses were clear.

continue.text: I would continue to see how life on Mars develops. The sunset detail gave the practical construction a human purpose.
